data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 单车后座的晚风轻搂
data.description: 夏日傍晚的河堤斜坡上，单车迎风飞驰。坐在后座上的烧盐柠檬双手环抱在你的腰间，将脸颊贴在你的后背上，短发随风轻舞，轻快地哼着不成调的夏日歌谣。
data.location: breezy grassy riverside path at dusk
data.action: riding on bicycle backseat, arms wrapped around partner waist, head leaning on his back, smiling blissfully in the evening breeze
data.lighting: cool violet and orange dusk sky reflecting on river water
data.mood: pure nostalgic youth, sweet summer breeze romance, heart-fluttering trust
data.promptProse: Riding on bicycle backseat along a grassy riverside, Lemon Yakishio hugs partner waist with windblown short hair and a peaceful blissful smile.
data.animaCaption: Lemon Yakishio hugging partner waist happily on bicycle backseat.
